templates.name: 照片出屏行走
templates.name_en: Photo steps out of screen and walks in scene
templates.description: 图1任意照片中的人物（必选，只取人物本身，忽略图1背景），图2场景+媒介（必选：场景环境和显示媒介都从图2取）。照片显示在图2场景里的媒介上，人物从平面静止状态逐渐立体，走出屏幕/画框，进入图2场景自由行走。
templates.description_en: The person in any Img1 photo (required; only the person is taken and the Img1 background ignored), Img2 scene plus medium (required: both the environment and the display medium come from Img2). The photo is shown on the medium inside the Img2 scene, and the figure gradually gains depth from a flat still image, steps out of the screen or frame and walks freely into the Img2 scene.
templates.generation_mode: Reference to Video (参考生视频)【图1人物+图2场景+媒介】
templates.prompt:
[CRITICAL REFERENCE ROLE ASSIGNMENT / 参考图角色分配 - HIGHEST PRIORITY - READ THIS FIRST]:
This video uses TWO reference images with STRICTLY SEPARATED roles. DO NOT mix them up:
- <Picture 1>@图1 = CHARACTER ONLY. Use <Picture 1>@图1 ONLY for the person's face, identity, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, body type, height proportions, and exact clothing outfit. COMPLETELY IGNORE THE BACKGROUND OF <Picture 1>@图1. The background of <Picture 1>@图1 is NOT the scene, NOT the environment, NOT where the video takes place. Throw away everything in <Picture 1>@图1 except the person.
- <Picture 2>@图2 = SCENE + MEDIUM. Use <Picture 2>@图2 for EVERYTHING ELSE. The entire video's environment, architecture, lighting, props, floor, walls, color temperature, and atmosphere MUST match <Picture 2>@图2. ALSO, the display medium that exists IN <Picture 2>@图2 — its exact type (phone screen / picture frame / TV / computer monitor / tablet / etc.), shape, size, color, material, and how it's held or placed — MUST be copied EXACTLY from <Picture 2>@图2. The photo from <Picture 1>@图1 (the person) appears displayed ON this medium from <Picture 2>@图2.

【绝对不能搞反】
图1@图1 = 人物专用。只从图1@图1取人物（脸、发型、肤色、身材、衣服）。图1@图1的背景完全忽略，不是场景，不是环境，不是视频发生的地方。
图2@图2 = 场景+媒介专用。整个视频的环境、建筑、灯光、道具、地面、墙面、色温、氛围全部从图2@图2来。图2@图2里那个显示媒介（手机/画框/电视/电脑/平板等）的类型、形状、大小、颜色、材质、怎么摆放的，全部从图2@图2照抄。图1@图1的人物照片显示在图2@图2这个媒介上。

[ANTI-GHOSTING / 防重影铁律 - ABSOLUTE CRITICAL]:
- The character is ONE single, solid, fully opaque, physically continuous body at ALL times.
- ABSOLUTELY NO double exposure, NO ghosting, NO afterimage, NO echo, NO semi-transparent body, NO split-body, NO layered duplicates.
- The transformation from 2D photo to 3D person is a SINGLE continuous process — the photo's pixels solidify into a real human body, not two overlapping figures. The 2D version and the 3D version NEVER coexist.
- 严禁重影/残影/分身/叠影/半透明人体/多重曝光。照片变真人是连续的单体实体化过程。

[ANTI-MIXUP / 防混淆铁律]:
- DO NOT use the background from <Picture 1>@图1 as the scene. The scene is ONLY from <Picture 2>@图2.
- DO NOT invent a new medium. The medium is ONLY the one shown in <Picture 2>@图2.
- DO NOT place the person into <Picture 1>@图1's background. The person walks in <Picture 2>@图2's scene.

integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-10s] Cinematic, realistic, natural camera movement. The entire scene is EXACTLY the environment from <Picture 2>@图2 — same location, same lighting, same props, same atmosphere. The display medium that exists in <Picture 2>@图2 (exact device as shown in <Picture 2>@图2, in its exact position and orientation) is showing a flat 2D photo of the person from <Picture 1>@图1. The person in the photo is perfectly motionless, like a printed picture on the screen surface.
【ACTION】At 0.0-3.0s, the photo inside the medium slowly "comes alive": the person in the image blinks, moves their eyes slightly, and their body gains subtle depth — skin gains texture, hair strands become individual, clothing fabric gains folds and sheen. The photo image rises off the flat surface in a smooth, continuous motion, becoming a solid 3D human while the face and outfit remain IDENTICAL to <Picture 1>@图1. At 3.0-6.0s, the person steps out of the medium — first one foot crosses the boundary of the screen/frame, then the whole body emerges and stands on the ground in the scene from <Picture 2>@图2. The medium's surface now shows an empty background (or a soft blurred reflection) where the person used to be. At 6.0-10.0s, the person walks naturally and freely within the scene from <Picture 2>@图2 — taking a few steps forward, looking around the environment with curiosity, adjusting posture naturally. The outfit, face, and hair stay exactly as <Picture 1>@图1 throughout.【/ACTION】Face, hairstyle, expression and outfit remain identical to <Picture 1>@图1 throughout; no distortion, no extra limbs, no duplicate figures. The scene AND the display medium remain EXACTLY as shown in <Picture 2>@图2.

overall_soundscape: Ambient room tone of the scene from <Picture 2>@图2, soft electronic shimmer during the photo-to-3D transition, faint fabric rustle as the person moves, natural footsteps on the scene's floor surface.

non_diegetic_music: Subtle ambient score that matches the mood of the scene from <Picture 2>@图2, building gently as the person steps out, fading to neutral background music during the walk.
